0022600178.text: The Pacers (2-5, 12th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 3.5 games back) are on a four-game losing streak and are 0-3 at home, while the Grizzlies (6-0, 1st in the West and Southwest) have won six straight, including a 2-0 home record. Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (rest), Andrew Nembhard (neck), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (knee bruise), Larry Nance Jr. (illness), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), Pascal Siakam (rest), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost both games, most recently 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
